posts.title: More personal implemetations
posts.description: in my experience, cost of implementation went down a lot through AI coding - from hours to minutes. So I guess we will see way more personal, custom implementations. Quality will probably decrease: less thinking about architecture and maintainability, but speed and customization will increase. Choose what you need.

posts.title: 1 week projects: ultracycling track viewer
posts.description: My first project is a track viewer for my (ultra-)cycling rides. You can see it live: https://tracks.miku86.com/ . Purpose (Why?) posts.title: 1 week projects
posts.description: I've started to revive my "1 week projects"-project. Scratching my own itches, I'll build small applications to solve my own problems. Because code nowadays is nearly free, I will have enough free time to actually build the projects. The only constraint is that I will only invest roughly 1 week to build each application. I will use opencode and openspec so that slop will be small, or let's say not
